result.summary: The page is mostly well-designed, but there is a clear text overlap bug in the 'Popular right now' section where the delivery time and delivery fee strings collide, plus a horizontal clipping issue on the restaurant card row.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' the metadata line shows overlapping text: '25–30 min' and '€0 delivery' are rendered on top of each other (e.g. '25–3€0 delivery'), making both pieces of information unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout of the subtitle row so the time range, delivery fee, and category are separate non-overlapping elements (e.g. use a flex row with proper spacing/separators instead of absolutely positioned or negative-margin text).

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal card list is clipped at the right edge: 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off mid-word with no visible scroll affordance or padding, which can look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding plus a scroll indicator (gradient fade or partial next-card peek) so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable, and ensure card titles truncate with an ellipsis cleanly.

issues.description: The promo code line 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is small and low-contrast white-on-green, making the key offer details hard to scan.
issues.suggestion: Slightly increase font size/weight or contrast of the code and minimum-order text to improve legibility of the promotion terms.
